technical.summary: Mixed intermediate-term bullish structure (50/200 EMA, supertrend, hull) offset by weak short-term price positioning (below 21-EMA), overbought stochRSI, and below-cloud Ichimoku; moderate confluence with low volume support and no triggered strategy.

fundamental.summary: EIX shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 22 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (28/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and stale with no recent conviction signals.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (354.6), flat yield curve recession risk, rising dollar headwind, and imminent NFP event create severely unfavourable macro conditions for EIX despite moderate earnings timeline.

debate.key_bull_argument: Intermediate-term bullish structure (50/200 EMA/SMA bullish, supertrend, hull) with rising RSI and contrarian fear-zone opportunity at support (50.19) offers asymmetric risk/reward if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (354.6), imminent earnings in 22 days, zero fundamental catalysts, price below 21-EMA/20-50 structure, stochRSI overbought, and unfavourable macro (flat yield curve, rising dollar, NFP event) create compounding headwinds that outweigh technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: While intermediate-term technicals (50/200 EMA bullish, supertrend, hull) and contrarian fear-zone setup offer structural appeal, the combination of extreme VIX crisis (354.6), imminent earnings (22 days), zero fundamental conviction, and price weakness below 21-EMA creates asymmetric downside risk that outweighs entry merit.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings volatility in 22 days combined with macro crisis regime (VIX 354.6, flat yield curve, NFP event) could trigger sharp reversal despite technical support at 50.19.
